title: Excel: Excel canvas turns workbook data into a Copilot-generated report that refreshes itself
summary: Pass: the rollout facts, licensing caveats, Windows privacy control, client-qualified sensitivity label setting and audit searches are supported. One descriptive attribution needs narrowing: neither the roadmap nor Microsoft's notice specifies that canvas operates as the signed-in user on their own workbook.

claims.quote: If you're using the Group Policy Management tool, all these policy settings are located under User Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Microsoft Office 2016\Privacy\Trust Center. ... Allow the use of connected experiences in Office that analyze content

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
